driver.snap.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Extract a read-only source snapshot of the compiler at <sha> into scratch (git archive; no refs, branches or worktrees).
set -euo pipefail
sha="$1"
dest="$MISSION_SCRATCH/snap/$sha"
if [ ! -d "$dest/packages/compiler/src" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  git -C "$WT_DIR" archive "$sha" packages/compiler package.json | tar -x -C "$dest"
  ln -s "$WT_DIR/node_modules" "$dest/node_modules"
  ln -s "$WT_DIR/packages/compiler/node_modules" "$dest/packages/compiler/node_modules"
  for p in runtime runtime-rust; do ln -s "$WT_DIR/packages/$p" "$dest/packages/$p"; done
fi
echo "$dest"
driver.bisect.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""First-parent bisect over source snapshots (git archive into scratch; analysis only).
usage: bisect.py <good-sha> <bad-sha> <entry> <target> <needle-substring-of-diagnostic-message>"""
import json, os, subprocess, sys
good, bad, entry, target, needle = sys.argv[1:6]
wt = os.environ["WT_DIR"]; scratch = os.environ["MISSION_SCRATCH"]
revs = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", wt, "rev-list", "--first-parent", "--reverse", f"{good}..{bad}"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
revs = [subprocess.run(["git", "-C", wt, "rev-parse", good], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()] + revs
label = os.path.basename(entry).replace(".ts", "")
def probe(sha):
    short = sha[:8]
    snap = subprocess.run([f"{scratch}/driver/snap.sh", short], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]
    out = f"{scratch}/runs/bisect/{label}-{target}/{short}"
    env = dict(os.environ, COMPILER_ROOT=snap, COMPILER_SNAPSHOT=sha)
    r = subprocess.run([f"{wt}/node_modules/.bin/tsx", f"{scratch}/driver/probe.mjs", "analyze", entry, out, target, "release", "none"], cwd=snap, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        rep = json.load(open(f"{out}/analyze.json"))
    except Exception as e:
        return ("error", f"no report: {r.stderr[-300:]}")
    if rep.get("exception"):
        return ("error", rep["exception"]["message"][:200])
    diags = rep["coverage"]["diagnostics"]
    hit = [d for d in diags if needle in d["message"]]
    return ("bad" if hit else "good", f"{len(diags)} diagnostics; stats {rep['coverage']['stats']}; " + "; ".join(sorted({d['code']+':'+d['message'][:70] for d in diags}))[:400])
lo, hi = 0, len(revs) - 1
log = []
s_lo = probe(revs[lo]); s_hi = probe(revs[hi])
log.append((revs[lo], *s_lo)); log.append((revs[hi], *s_hi))
print("endpoints", revs[lo][:8], s_lo, revs[hi][:8], s_hi, flush=True)
assert s_lo[0] == "good" and s_hi[0] == "bad", "endpoints do not bracket the change"
while hi - lo > 1:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    s = probe(revs[mid]); log.append((revs[mid], *s))
    print(revs[mid][:8], s, flush=True)
    if s[0] == "good": lo = mid
    elif s[0] == "bad": hi = mid
    else:
        # an unanalyzable snapshot: walk linearly toward the bad side
        j = mid + 1
        while j < hi:
            s2 = probe(revs[j]); log.append((revs[j], *s2)); print(" skip->", revs[j][:8], s2, flush=True)
            if s2[0] != "error": break
            j += 1
        if j >= hi or s2[0] == "bad": hi = mid if j >= hi else j; 
        else: lo = j
        if s2[0] == "bad" and j < hi: hi = j
desc = lambda sha: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", wt, "log", "-1", "--format=%h %ad %s", "--date=iso-strict", sha], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
result = {"entry": entry, "target": target, "needle": needle, "lastGood": desc(revs[lo]), "firstBad": desc(revs[hi]), "firstParentRange": len(revs) - 1, "steps": [{"commit": c[:8], "state": st, "detail": d} for c, st, d in log]}
os.makedirs(f"{scratch}/runs/bisect", exist_ok=True)
json.dump(result, open(f"{scratch}/runs/bisect/{label}-{target}.json", "w"), indent=1)
print("LAST GOOD:", result["lastGood"]); print("FIRST BAD:", result["firstBad"])
